scope: eS3o|bayes|inherited. 3D Bayesian phi_h, Q2-y 1-17, 422 nonempty cells. Input file unfolded/eS3o|bayes|inherited_WSpline_ColGenRatio.root copied to refinement/eS3o_bayes_inherited/histograms.root. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication.
start_mode: manual. The run-local guide is refinement/eS3o_bayes_inherited/refine_init.py, loaded from Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed. Shared Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py and Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py were not edited.
changed: Pass 1 returned 0 with 422 Fit_Pars_from_3D_Bayesian cells and was not treated as finished. Median chi2/NDF was 1.50. Many manual keys exist with no B or C start, so the second fit pass collapsed near zero; (8,21) was pinned at B=0 by limits [0, 0.1], and (16,12) was pinned by C limits [-0.1, 0.04]. Overlays of a wide |B|,|C|<0.95 cosine are in overlays/. Fifteen bins were opened around that wide cosine (B +/- 0.20, C +/- 0.15) and Q2-y 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 13, 14, 15, and 16 were remade. Every edited bin improved and matched the wide-fit chi2/NDF. No unedited cell in those Q2-y bins moved. Unselected Q2-y 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, and 17 were not rewritten; Q2-y 5 z 1 in the ROOT file still matches pass 1. The new json path fit_pass2.json holds only the remade batch, and fit.json merges it back onto pass 1 so all 422 cells remain. None of those parameters sits on the opened limit. overlays_pass2 shows the stored curve on the wide cosine. No third pass. Median chi2/NDF after the remake is 1.46.
left_bins: (1,17) stays at chi2/NDF 6.30. The wide cosine only reaches 5.50 and both curves miss the same scattered points, so the guide was not moved. (4,28) has four phi points and NDF 1; the wide cosine invents a peak between them, so it was left at 4.04. (7,35) has four points and the stored and wide curves already agree, so the tight manual limit was left. High chi2/NDF that already matches the free cosine was left: (2,4) 4.316, (5,14) 4.187, (3,14) 4.178, and (1,29) 3.668. There is no 5D family and no nominal-shape override.
unresolved: Four cells have NDF 0 and were not replaced with a nominal value: (12,24) has one phi point, and (4,15), (4,22), and (8,25) have three. (4,22) still has a non-physical B and C because three points cannot fix the cosine. Empty-integral histograms and z_pT Bin_All were not fitted. No publication.
